description: Upload files from this computer with no file dialog. Point ref at what the user would use: an Upload or Attach button, a drop area, a chat box that takes pasted images, or a file input. If the button opens a menu ("From computer"), call again on the menu item. Without ref it only lists the files paths match. Unless bypass mode is on or the site is allowed, the user is asked first; don't retry a declined upload.

paths.description: Absolute paths; ~, %VAR% and $VAR work, as do a wildcard in the name, a folder, or download:<id> from list_downloads. A wrong path returns similar files.

ref.description: Element to upload through: a button, drop area, text box or file input. Leave out to only list what paths match.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

via.description: Force one way of delivering, when the automatic choice was wrong.

name: upload_file
title: Upload files from this computer
